title: The watchdog's “waits for the owner” question: an action the owner can take only after something that still runs (a build, an export) is not a wait on them yet; the same action once it is possible is
note: Live case: a result listed “your action: take the part off the machine” while the job was at 89% and an hour from its end; the owner got a to-do he could not act on. Texts are made up and neutral. Input = the language line + the end of the result, as the watchdog sends it (no open cards). approve-now-run-after: a yes the owner can give now for a step that runs after the job is still a wait on them; already-done: the action is done, nothing is needed.

turns.input:

The first build is running: 89% at 15:13, by its pace it ends about 16:30. Then you pick up the file from the build machine's USB stick, and I start the second build, about 5 hours.
